about: The Big Creek watershed covers about 40 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 3 smaller watersheds: Indian Camp Creek, McCoy Creek and Lower Big Creek. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 710 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 440 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are McCoy Creek, Dry Branch, Big Creek and Crossroads Creek. Communities here include Wentzville, Flint Hill, Foristell and Josephville. Big Creek flows into the Cuivre River, which empties into the Mississippi River.
